author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Golfer at the top of the backswing (human_ref full_body): r4 head 8 above a vertical neck run, torso leaning back to the hip, straight arms to the hands, club over the shoulder at 45 degrees ending in a short club head, back leg down-left and front knee bent; the head now sits on the body instead of floating inside the swing.
omissions: Outlined silhouette limbs become single strokes; the curled club head becomes a short level stub.
